app_descripcion: Search the scientific literature on rare diseases in PubMed and get a summary with verifiable references.
comun_aviso_web_corto: This is not a diagnostic tool and does not provide medical advice. Check every statement against the original paper using its PMID.
comun_aviso_no_diagnostico: This tool is an aid for searching and summarising the literature. It is not a diagnostic tool and does not constitute medical advice. Always check every statement against the original paper using its PMID.
form_ayuda_avanzada: These are added to the query sent to PubMed. You can search by author alone, with no term.
form_etiqueta_forzar: Regenerate the summary even if a recent one is in the local cache
form_buscando: Searching PubMed and generating the summary…
err_titulo_busqueda: The search could not be completed.
err_sin_criterios: Enter a gene, syndrome or search term, or use the advanced search to search by author or pathogen.
res_sin_resultados: PubMed returned no articles for «$consulta$» in the last $dias$ days.
res_sin_resultados_sugerencia: Try widening the day window, raising the maximum number of papers, or searching by gene name instead of syndrome.
res_desde_cache: Served from the local cache — originally generated on $fecha$ at $hora$ UTC. Tick «Regenerate the summary» to create a new one.
res_sin_resumen: A summary could not be generated for this search right now. The papers retrieved from PubMed are listed below unsummarised — review them directly.
res_estado_vacio: Enter a gene, syndrome or term and press «Search» to see the summary and references.
fil_ayuda: This filters what is already on screen and does not query PubMed again. To find more articles by an author, put it in «Advanced search» and run the search again.
exp_ayuda: Paste it as a text source in NotebookLM or Gemini Notebook. It includes the search term, the summary with its PMIDs, the references and the medical notice.
exp_fallo: Could not copy automatically (the browser is not granting clipboard access). The text is selected above: copy it with Ctrl+C.
fav_descripcion: Papers you have saved, with your notes. The data comes from the local database: PubMed is not queried to show them.
fav_vacio: You have not saved any papers yet. Search for something and press «Save to favourites» on the results you are interested in.
fav_error_titulo: The operation could not be completed.
fav_placeholder_nota: Write here whatever you want to remember about this paper
fav_confirmar_quitar: This favourite has a note, which will be deleted. Remove it anyway?
fav_confirmar_borrar_nota:
This favourite has a note, which will be deleted:

«$nota$»

Remove it from favourites?
fav_error_guardar: The favourite could not be saved.
fav_error_servidor: Could not reach the local server.
fav_err_pmid_desconocido: PMID $pmid$ is not in the local database, so it cannot be saved to favourites. Only papers that have appeared in a previous search can be saved: search first for the term that returns it and save it from there.
fav_err_no_marcado: PMID $pmid$ is not in favourites, so a note cannot be added to it. Save it to favourites first.
fav_err_pmid_invalido: «$pmid$» does not look like a PMID: a PMID is a number, such as 38123456.
alc_aviso_sin_sujeto: This search includes no disease term or pathogen —only filters such as the author— so it was not possible to check whether it falls within the scope of this tool (rare diseases). The results may include work outside that scope. The search was run anyway.
alc_aviso_ambiguo: The term «$termino$» could not be confidently classified as within the scope of this tool (rare diseases): $motivo$ The search was run anyway; interpret the results with caution.
alc_aviso_no_concluyente: It was not possible to check whether «$termino$» falls within the scope of this tool (rare diseases): $motivo$. The search was run anyway.
alc_mensaje_bloqueo:
The term «$termino$» is outside the scope of this tool, which is limited to genes and syndromes related to rare diseases. Reason: $motivo$
No search was sent to PubMed. Try a gene (e.g. SCN1A) or a rare syndrome (e.g. Dravet syndrome).
idi_aviso: The term «$termino$» appears to be written in Spanish or in one of Spain's co-official languages (Catalan, Basque or Galician). PubMed indexes mostly English-language articles, so you will probably find far fewer results than exist: try rewriting it in English (for example «Dravet syndrome» instead of «síndrome de Dravet», or the gene name, which is written the same in every language). The search was run anyway with the term as typed.
off_servidor_caido: Could not reach paper-search on your computer. Check that it is running (double-click run.bat) and try again.
off_sin_internet: No internet connection. You can browse the favourites you have already saved, but not search PubMed or generate summaries.
off_buscar_sin_conexion: Searching needs an internet connection: PubMed and the summariser require the network. Any favourites you have already saved are still available.
off_copia_aviso: You are viewing a copy saved on $fecha$. paper-search is not running, so this data may be out of date and cannot be edited.
ext_descripcion: Search PubMed for the gene or syndrome you have selected, using your local paper-search.
ext_popup_intro: Select a gene or syndrome on any page and right-click, or type it here.
ext_sin_termino: Type a term, or select it on a page and right-click.
